containment_proposal: Isolate WS-FIN-07 and FS-01 and block 203.0.113.66 and 198.51.100.23 at the perimeter
expected_findings: External RDP brute force from 203.0.113.66 preceded a successful Administrator logon on WS-FIN-07
Defender was disabled, shadow copies deleted and recovery disabled before execution
Persistence was established via scheduled task SysHealthCheck and new admin account svc_backup2$
Lateral movement over SMB ADMIN$ deployed encryptor.exe to FS-01
encryptor.exe mass-encrypted 38,412 files with .locked extension and dropped ransom note HOW_TO_RECOVER.hta
narrative: Ransomware operator brute-forced RDP on WS-FIN-07, established persistence, moved laterally to FS-01 over SMB, deployed encryptor.exe, mass-encrypted shares and dropped ransom notes while beaconing to C2.
